criteria.statement: The CLI constructs an operator client from a bunker URI, separate signer relay, and persistent NIP-46 client key without local operator identity key material.
The injected remote signer signs ContextVM events and NIP-42 AUTH challenges.
Partial, ambiguous, or mixed signer configuration fails before relay publication.
The deployed Stew NIP-46 session completes bunker connect, ping, public-key resolution, and operator event signing.
